content: testcontainers-python 4.15.0 spins a real postgres:17-alpine container (~3s startup, once per session), parallel-safe, matches prod. pytest-postgresql 9.1.0 needs a local postgres binary/initdb but no Docker. Recommend testcontainers for parity (Neon = real Postgres) with a session-scoped container + per-test transaction rollback; keep a Neon branch for pre-merge smoke tests only.
